usedFor: Sukam Apps CRM holds leads, and Sangam CRM mirrors them when “Lead Updated” runs “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “Lead Updated” in Sukam Apps CRM, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: An edited lead in Sukam Apps CRM updates the same lead in Sangam CRM, matched by ID, email or phone.

watchOut: “Lead Updated” in Sukam Apps CRM is polling, so changes reach Sangam CRM after a scheduled check.
